line: Crowley's Princess of Disks: Hé final of the Name (pdf p140); the earthy part of Earth (pdf p171); no zodiacal attribution (pdf p140).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princesses (pdf p140) and on the Princess of Disks (pdf p171).

quotes.quote: The Princesses represent the Hé final of the Name.
The Princess of Disks, the last of the Court cards, represents the earthy part of Earth.

sections.title: Zodiacal attribution
sections.line: Crowley on the Princesses and the Zodiac (pdf p140).

quotes.quote: The Princesses have no Zodiacal attribution.

sections.title: The figure
sections.line: Crowley on the crest and sceptre of the Princess of Disks, and on Womanhood (pdf p171).

quotes.quote: Her crest is the head of the ram, and her sceptre descends into the earth.
she is Womanhood in its ultimate projection
